card.title: The One Normal Thing
card.instruction: Remain modest while controlling the single ordinary resource everyone needs to survive the increasingly impossible situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This kitchen tile still has gravity. I'm just keeping a place for everyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pull me down. I can't hold the ceiling much longer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my hand. One foot on my tile, please; leave room for your dad.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Dad's floating out the window. Let me take your place and reach him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay as the anchor. Nothing grand; climb onto my shoulders and I'll allocate the next foothold.

mechanism: A calls the role simple place-keeping while retaining the one gravity tile and allocating access during a floating rescue.
confusable: Unlike ordinary emergency command, the power must derive from one small everyday resource while A downplays its significance.
comparison: The tile alternative preserves the anchor position and delegates reach; the spoon alternative delegates movement while preserving food distribution.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
